steps.title: PostgreSQL Document Types Read-Back
steps.description: Confirm doc.document_types rows exist for pilot tenant under RLS-enabled schema
steps.query: SELECT id, code, name FROM doc.document_types WHERE tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' LIMIT 1

steps.title: Schema Ownership / RLS Audit
steps.description: Verify stage_document_requirements has RLS enabled and FORCED
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'doc' AND c.relname = 'stage_document_requirements' AND c.relrowsecurity = true AND c.relforcerowsecurity = true

steps.title: Negative RBAC — Unauthenticated Types Blocked
steps.description: Unauthenticated GET on document types contract returns HTTP 401
